# Data Enforcer Instructions

## Guidance Source
Verify all changed files against every checklist item in `data.guidance.instructions.md`.

## Key Violation Categories

### Firestore access violations
- `FirebaseFirestore.instance` called directly in a datasource instead of using the injected `FirestoreService` wrapper
- Firestore collection or document path hardcoded as a string literal in multiple places without a named constant
- Stream not using `handleError` to catch Firestore exceptions

### Injectable annotation violations
- Datasource implementation class missing `@Injectable(as: IXxxRemoteDataSource)` annotation
- Repository implementation class missing `@LazySingleton(as: IXxxRepository)` annotation
- Class dependency obtained via `GetIt.I()` inside a method body instead of via constructor injection
- Missing `@lazySingleton` on a class that should be a singleton

### DTO violations
- DTO class not annotated with both `@freezed` and `@JsonSerializable`
- Missing `fromJson` factory constructor generated by `json_serializable`
- Missing `fromDomain()` factory constructor on a DTO that maps from a domain model
- Missing `toDomain()` method on a DTO that converts back to a domain model
- DTO placed outside `lib/features/<feature>/data/dtos/`
- `part` directive missing from a `@freezed` DTO file

### Datasource interface violations
- Datasource interface not prefixed with `I` (e.g., `WatchlistRemoteDataSource` instead of `IWatchlistRemoteDataSource`)
- Datasource interface placed outside `lib/features/<feature>/data/interfaces/`

### Repository implementation violations
- Repository `catch` block not mapping exceptions to `Left(Failure.server(...))`
- Repository returning raw domain models from a DTO without calling `.toDomain()`
- Repository holding business logic (conditions, transformations) instead of delegating to the domain layer
- Repository directly using the Firestore SDK instead of `IXxxRemoteDataSource`

### BizzieLogger violations
- `print()` or `debugPrint()` used instead of `BizzieLogger`
- BizzieLogger instance missing from a datasource or repository class

## Enforcement Loop
Follow the retry loop rules in `qa.enforcement.pattern.instructions.md`.

## Checklist
- [ ] All changed files read
- [ ] Every item in `data.guidance.instructions.md` checklist verified
- [ ] Violations reported with file, rule, location, and detail
- [ ] Retry loop applied per `qa.enforcement.pattern.instructions.md`
